notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Hi!

New bug fixes and improvements. It includes tweak and gameplay adjustments, Vertical axis invertion option for mouse or pad (yes!)

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

--- Patch Notes ---
Controls:  Add an option to control menu to invert the vertical axis for mouse and pad.

SandBox:
- Fix Bridger behaviour that can be stuck in front of Voraxo.
- Allow entities to reproduce more that palette limit per entity.
- Bridgers, Papyvorus, Predators, insects can reproduce 2 or 3 entities at a time if population is high.

Chapter 3.4: Make sure player have enough "Bridger" in any situation

notes.title: Patch 1.01 HotFix
notes.content:
Hi!

We’ve just published an important fix. This patch fixes a simulation terrain issue not running properly on lower graphic cards than GTX 970 like GTX 680 or GTX 780.

Cheers,
[i]Paper Beast Team[/i]
